desc: a small sleek BLACK house cat sitting upright on its haunches, front paws together, body turned three-quarter toward the RIGHT, head looking at the viewer, bright yellow-green eyes, a tiny pink nose, glossy black fur with subtle dark blue-grey highlights, its long tail curled on the ground beside its paws. Frame 1: the tail tip lies curled flat around the front paws. Frame 2: the tail tip is lifted and flicked up in a lazy curve. Everything else (body, head, ears, eyes) stays exactly identical in both frames.
